source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When your turn starts and you have fulfilled the Oath you currently hold, determine another Oath as the army rules describe, but no Deed or Quality already chosen may be chosen again; if a random roll gives one already chosen, pick an unchosen one instead. Once every Deed and every Quality has been chosen, no further Oath is determined. Qualities of fulfilled Oaths keep applying to all your models with Code Chivalric. Completing the Deed of an additional Oath gives you 1CP in place of its usual reward, however that Deed or Quality was chosen.
